_meta.description: Whitelist of normal, legal, and professional wealth management requests used to calibrate statistical boundaries (per-signal Z-score noise floor and WHITELIST_THRESHOLD).  Coverage spans administrative servicing, routine trading, retirement and tax planning, fixed income, options/hedging in their legitimate uses, charitable giving, estate, and casual phrasings of the same.  When expanding, keep prompts that a compliant broker-dealer would unambiguously execute without escalation; ambiguous cases belong in attack_prompts.json with the appropriate label.
